steps.en: Install the package into your Python environment
steps.zh: 把包装进你的 Python 环境

steps.en: Point AutoModel at a Hugging Face repo id or a local model path
steps.zh: 用 AutoModel 指向 HF 仓库 id 或本地模型路径

steps.en: Splits the checkpoint into one shard per layer on disk (first run only)
steps.zh: 把检查点按层切成一个个分片落盘，仅首次运行

steps.en: Tokenize the prompt and call generate — the same code as plain transformers
steps.zh: 照常分词并调 generate，与普通 transformers 写法一致

steps.en: Loads each layer disk to device just before it runs, frees it right after
steps.zh: 每层轮到它之前才从磁盘载入设备，算完立刻释放

steps.en: Lets transformers run the real forward pass and returns the sequence
steps.zh: 由 transformers 跑真正的前向并返回序列

value.en: You run a model far larger than your VRAM without quantizing or converting it — paying in disk space and seconds per token
value.zh: 不用量化、不用转换格式就能跑远超显存的大模型，代价是磁盘空间与每秒级的等待
